messages:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: page fired for service=redwood-inference-api alert=high-p99-latency threshold=3000ms (p99=4520ms) -- triggered at 1775006789
IncidentBot: alert details — rule: inference.p99 > 3000ms for 10m. Affected route: POST /v1/generate -> inference-svc-production. Recent deploys: model-serving/quantized-v2 @ 1775006200.
Alex C: acked. taking lead. asking for current impact numbers and any running runbook pointers.
Maria P: seeing sustained tail spikes on the inference-host logs, lots of RPC retries + long KV cache lookups. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 98% -> 63% around 03:06 UTC.
Samir: looks correlated w/ the quantized-v2 rollout. heap/oom not obvious but latency per-request jumps when cache miss + cold KV population.
James R: customer-facing impact: 12 tenants have increased 500/504s over last 15m, most are hitting p99 > 4s. No full outage but UX degrades.
Alex C: immediate mitigations I want to try: 1) scale inference replicas, 2) pin routing to model-v1-small fallback, 3) throttle/shorten long tails. Who can run the scaler?
Samir: running scale now. kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-svc --replicas=8
Samir: scaling done; pods coming up (3 -> 8). watching metrics.
Maria P: enabling routing fallback to model-v1-small for heavy-traffic customers: updating routing policy in console -> route override set for tenant groups A/B. command: `redwood route update --service inference --rule "if p99>2000 -> model=v1-small"`
Alex C: good. also enable aggressive KV prefill for hottest prefixes while we repopulate cache. I pushed a temporary job: `jobs/cache-prefill --tenants top20 --window 5m`
IncidentBot: automation note: auto-fallback policy applied to 6 tenants at 1775007001.
PagerDuty: escalation timer suppressed (ack by Alex C). next auto-escalation to Samir in 12m if no progress.
James R: quick customer summary for status page: "We are observing higher than normal request latency (p95/p99) on inference API due to increased KV cache miss rate after a model rollout. We are scaling capacity and routing impacted traffic to a smaller model. Some customers may see 4xx/5xx transient errors."
Alex C: markers: current p95=820ms (ok), p99=2100ms (improving from 4520ms). Still SLO burn at p99 though (~68% of window). Keep monitoring for next 10m.
Maria P: found noisy host node i-0a12 that had network queue depth spikes and slow NVMe. cordon + drain now: `kubectl cordon i-0a12 && kubectl drain i-0a12 --ignore-daemonsets`
Samir: drained node. pods rescheduled. initial tail latency dropped on those pods.
Alex C: good. follow-ups: 1) rollback quantized-v2 for gradual rollback if p99 doesn't recover, 2) keep routing fallback for 30m, 3) notify account execs for top-5 tenants. Who's on account contact? James?
James R: i'll ping account execs + post brief on status.redwood.com/incidents/xxxx. will attach metrics screenshot.
Oncall Rotation: reminder — handoff in 2h. if this remains active at handoff, please add it to the handoff notes and mark incident as 'ongoing'.
IncidentBot: outage status: INCIDENT-OPEN (latency SLO burn) — severity: sev-2. created incident ticket INC-2026-113.
Alex C: ok current plan: watch for 20m. if p99 doesn't get <1500ms then rollback quantized-v2. if we hit >80% SLO burn or errors spike -> declare sev-1 and page execs.
Samir: rolling back quantized-v2 now (orchestration rollback started). `kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model=quantized-v1 --record`
Maria P: after rollback, p99 down to 900ms, p95 700ms. KV hit-rate recovering to 90%.
Alex C: :thumbsup: looks stabilized. leaving routing fallback on for 10m then remove. James — please send the customer-facing update and flag top-5 for proactive outreach.
James R: will send update and create follow-up with account teams.
Alex C: declaring incident still open but mitigated. creating postmortem placeholder; owners: Samir (cause), Maria (infra), James (customer comms).
Oncall Rotation: i will take the formal handoff if still ongoing at 1775009000. otherwise Alex, stop monitoring and we resume normal ops.
Alex C: handing off in 45m unless any regression. thanks everyone for quick actions. :coffee:
